wave.map.ahead_tip: How far the map reaches ahead of the bow
wave.map.auto_domain_tip: The map reaches half a waterline length ahead of the bow, three behind the stern and far enough to each side to show the wash line
wave.map.behind_tip: How far the map reaches behind the stern

wave.method.hover: Michell's thin-ship theory: a slender hull at steady speed in deep, calm water, with small waves and no viscosity, spray or squat. It gives the waves far from the hull and their drag, not the water at the hull. It does not suit planing hulls.
wave.method.title: Thin-ship theory (Michell)
wave.note.catamaran: catamaran: each demihull is taken as symmetric about its own centreplane, as in Michell's resistance
wave.note.far_field: Far-field thin-ship (Michell) waves: free waves only, without the local disturbance, so the elevation near the hull is not the hull wave profile.
wave.plot.drag_caption: Wave drag coefficient C_w × 10³ vs Fn
wave.plot.drag_marker_hint: marker: Fn {fn} = {kn} kn; click or drag to set the speed
wave.plot.wash_caption: Wash at {d} m: elevation (m) vs x (m)
wave.readout.crest_tip: The highest and lowest water on the map, away from the hull (far field only).
wave.readout.drag_tip: Michell's thin-ship estimate of the wave-making resistance at this speed, and its coefficient on the wetted surface.
wave.readout.hull_speed_tip: The speed at which the transverse wave is about as long as the waterline: a rule of thumb, not a limit.
wave.readout.interference_tip: The pair's wave drag against twice one demihull's alone at this speed: below that (favourable) the wave systems partly cancel.
wave.readout.spacing_tip: The distance between the demihulls' centrelines.
wave.readout.wash_tip: The largest crest-to-trough height along a line this far to the side: a thin-ship estimate in deep water, not a wash assessment against any rule.
wave.readout.wavelength_tip: The length of the transverse waves behind the hull, crest to crest, against the waterline length.
wave.regime.hull_speed: Around hull speed: about one wave along the hull, the stern settling into its trough. Wave drag climbs steeply.
wave.regime.low: Several waves along the hull; wave drag is small.
wave.regime.past_hull_speed: Past hull speed: the hull climbs its own bow wave. Thin-ship theory loses accuracy here; consider a planing analysis.
wave.regime.rising: Wave drag rising: the waves lengthen towards the hull's length.
